consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at P-8302

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives on P-8302 and PT-8302 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. P-8302 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 22 December 2021 a potential incident was recorded on P-8302 and PT-8302 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
